# Third-party libraries

| File | Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js` | pdf.js (Mozilla) | 3.11.174 | Apache-2.0 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/ |
| `pdf-lib.min.js` | pdf-lib | 1.17.1 | MIT | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf-lib/1.17.1/ |

pdf.js 3.x is used (not 4.x+) because it ships a classic-script build, which works when the app is opened from `file://`.
